description: Projects 10-turn forward session caching economics for a single target model under Case A (100% static prefix) and Case B (90% static prefix + 10% dynamic tail) using its exact catalog rate card. Stateless in-memory actuarial calculation requiring no API keys; prompts under 1,024 tokens bypass warm cache discounts. Returns JSON with provider_cache_protocol_mechanism, ten_turn_cost_comparison_on_same_model, and two_vector_actuarial_reference_table. Use this tool for 10-turn forward ROI planning on one model; use analyze_same_model_cache for one observed usage receipt or optimize_prompt_cache_layout to fix mid-prompt cache invalidation.

model.description: Target LLM model ID ('vendor/model-slug', e.g. 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5', or 'openai/gpt-4.1').

prompt_tokens.description: Input prompt token count per turn (>= 1024 cacheable threshold).

name: pin_single_model_prefix_cache
